thread:
sam: Quick sync re: EU rollout requests. Customer wants opt-in only, per-tenant A/B of quantized vs baseline, and an auditable auto-fallback.

julia: They stressed audit trail + a one-click console kill. Also want cost delta per tenant.

alex: Proposed minimal safe plan: shadow traffic for 48h, then A/B sample at 2% (deterministic by tenant hash), then 10% cohorts. Keep shadow until warmers finish.

toni: Ops requirements: define circuit with two signals (p95 latency, token burn). If breach, trigger staged eviction to US and emit `auto_fallback` events.

sam: Feature flag plan: `eu_rollout_ab_v1` states: off / shadow / ab / rollout. Only opt-in-tagged tenants are eligible in `ab`. KMS-bound for `rollout`.

alex: A/B pseudocode: ``if flag=='ab' and tenant.optin: variant = 'quant' if hash(tenant_id)%100<50 else 'fp32'``. Implement `--dry-run` to log planned weight changes.

toni: Eviction ramp: [75,50,25,0] EU weight, 60s between steps. Emit audit at each step containing reason + metric snapshot. Also add fast-kill (immediate 0) for manual kill-switch.
julia: CS asks for tenant opt-out button, one-click kill, and a visible estimated monthly cost delta (can be rough).
sam: Launch gates: 5 days p95 <200ms on sampled tenants, error rate <0.4%, audit events for auto actions, console toggle present.
alex: Implementation owners: Eng builds flag + AB controller + dry-run; SRE builds eviction actuator + alerts + runbook; CS prepares comms + billing guidance.

toni: We'll also require prefix warmers during shadow and a KV cache warm step before moving to ab. Add a config toggle for warm-up concurrency to avoid overload.
julia: I'll craft comms and a short opt-in checklist to send to the customer once dry-run passes.
sam: Risks: cold-start spikes for quantized shards and model quality delta. Recommend adding a lightweight quality check on sampled outputs during shadow.
alex: Will add a quick eval job in staging that samples responses and compares quality metrics.

deploy-bot: ab-controller v0.2 rolling to staging (build 6123) :rocket:
sam: Action items: @alex push dry-run + audit events; @toni write runbook & alerts; @julia prepare comms + cost estimate; I'll author GA gating doc. 10m check after dry-run.
alex: Ack, PR incoming.
toni: Will post runbook link when ready.
sam: Thanks, everyone.
